national_posture.statement: The August 23 IMSR kept the United States at National Preparedness Level 5, with 79 uncontained large fires, 124 active incidents, and 22,122 personnel assigned.
national_posture.level_meaning: national resources are fully committed, active geographic areas may need emergency measures, and potential for additional significant fires is high

national_posture.statement: The Aug 23 CIFFC situation report kept Canada at National Preparedness Level 5. It showed 121 full-response fires covering 615,506.0 hectares, 3,311 out-of-control fires covering 151,720.4 hectares, and 4,917 fires covering 4,321,122.8 hectares year to date.
national_posture.level_meaning: national demand is extreme, resources are fully committed, and international resources are being mobilized to sustain operations

incidents.name: Old Trails Fire
incidents.location: West of Spokane near Airway Heights
incidents.controlling_agency: California Interagency Incident Management Team 7 and Washington Department of Natural Resources

evacuation.description: Evacuations and area, road, and trail closures remained in effect around the Spokane fires.

incidents.operational_outlook: The latest available Aug 14 InciWeb record carried Old Trails at 3,176 acres and 98% containment; patrol and residual-heat work continued.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on the arson investigation, roughly 900 reported structures lost, evacuation impacts, emergency response, and residents beginning to return.
attention.methodology_note: Browser-visible search was capped at 60 unique result links; counts are censored observations and no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 655 lost structures are an unspecified-occupancy total and must not be converted into dwellings. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Grasshopper Fire
incidents.location: Mt. Hood National Forest near Highway 35
incidents.controlling_agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mt. Hood National Forest

evacuation.description: Incident information directs residents to current county evacuation levels and notes a forest closure order.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 23 InciWeb update reported 93,693 acres and 76% containment; active uphill runs, flanking, and group torching continued while residences and critical infrastructure remained threatened.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage emphasized continued growth, wind-driven behavior, community and evacuation concerns, and structure protection.
attention.methodology_note: Result count is a browser-visible, title-attributed sample; no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 35 lost structures are cumulative and unspecified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Widemouth 2 Fire
incidents.location: Fishlake National Forest between Kanosh, Meadow, and Fillmore
incidents.controlling_agency: Great Basin Complex Incident Management Team 2 and Fishlake National Forest

evacuation.description: The IMSR reported evacuations, road and area closures; the incident page directs residents to local evacuation information.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 23 NIFC table retained 129,741 acres and 93% containment as the latest controlling operational value; the latest available incident record described increasing containment and reduced staffing.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on continued fire growth, improved containment, monsoonal weather, and firefighting operations.
attention.methodology_note: News-area estimates do not replace the official IMSR acreage in the operational record.

incidents.analyst_note: **Source reconciliation:** The Aug 23 NIFC and latest available InciWeb records differ slightly on the latest acreage and control rate; this record uses the controlling NIFC incident-table value of 129,741 acres and 93% containment. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

global_overview.statement: The Aug 23 browser headline scan found current international coverage concentrated on Europe and wider global fire impacts, including Fontainebleau near Paris, European heat and wildfire risk, Southern Colombia, Indonesia, buried wartime ordnance, and Arctic-boreal smoke. The direct 24-hour query returned multiple current international headlines; the broader seven-day scan also showed Serbia assistance, Arctic, tropical-forest, UK, and global wildfire coverage. This is a headline scan, not comprehensive worldwide operational intelligence.
